profile.tagline: Backend Developer for Java and Kotlin, Spring Boot and microservices

summary.summary: Twelve years of backend development on the JVM. Builds REST services and event-driven systems for logistics and banking, with a focus on clean APIs and stable operation.

list.details:
- Kotlin and Spring Boot microservices for freight booking and tracking
- Event-driven integration with Kafka, PostgreSQL as main database
- Kubernetes on AWS (EKS), deployment with GitLab CI and Helm
- REST and gRPC interfaces to carriers and customs systems
- Unit tests with JUnit 5 and MockK for own code

- Java 11 and Spring services for payment processing and account management
- Oracle database, SOAP and REST interfaces to partner banks
- Jenkins builds, JUnit tests for business logic
- Production support in a rotating on-call duty

- Java EE and Spring projects for insurance and industry clients
- Integration of legacy systems through message queues and web services
- Maven, Subversion, later Git

- Feature development in a Java web application
- Bug fixing and small database migrations

list.title: Event gateway for carrier messages
list.tagline: A Kafka-based gateway that receives status messages from 30 carriers in different formats and publishes one common event.

list.title: Java to Kotlin migration
list.tagline: Step-by-step migration of a Spring service from Java to Kotlin while it stayed in production.
